integrity.proof_basis: Birth–death scale formula, Doob h-transform, Alexander first-return asymptotic, and a local defective-renewal theorem.

scientific_limitations: Nearest-neighbour birth–death chains only; no extension to bounded jumps larger than one is asserted.
The drift remainder must be \(o(1/[x(\log x)^2])\); weaker remainders may change the slowly varying factor.
The leading constant in the local-return asymptotic is positive but is not reduced to a closed form in all transition probabilities.
title: Local return asymptotics at a logarithmic Lamperti boundary
